name: AURA.
desc:
Welcome to a game where you cultivate AURA! The more Auras you earn, the more Auras you can unlock with different Phonk songs and crazy animations! There are several Phonk songs with different rhythms! 🗣

Use The Code "DarkWalkerChan" for 2X Aura For 2 Hour!
Use The Code "RileyBurger" for 2X Aura For 2 Hour!
Use The Code "hiti" for 2X Aura For 1 Hour!
Use The Code "deti" for 2X Aura For 10 Minutes!
Use The Code "NAVREAL" for 2X Aura For 10 Minutes!

This was remade by the original creator of the Aura Farm Game! 🌀

Farm Aura to Unlock Insane Phases with Different Phonks! 🗣🤑
With a certain amount of Aura, perform a rebirth to improve your multiplier! 🔄
If your Aura is the rarest, your music will be the loudest! and all others will decrease in volume! ⬆️⚡️

This is a simulation game! 🔄
This game contains Phonk! 🔊
